ARMA.name: Armor Addon
ARMA.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/ARMA. An armour addon is a model worn over a body part, and it has one model per race group. [measured: 766 ARMA records in Skyrim.esm; BODT is 12 bytes and DNAM is 12]

BOD2.name: Body Template
BOD2.note: The body template, 8 bytes. It is mutually exclusive with BODT.

BODT.name: Body Template
BODT.note: The body template, 12 bytes. It is mutually exclusive with BOD2.

DNAM.name: Data
DNAM.note: The male and female priorities, a detection sound value and the weapon adjustment.

MO2S.name: Alternate Texture Sets
MO2S.note: The alternate texture sets: how many there are, then each one's name, texture set and model index.

MO2T.name: Model Data
MO2T.note: The model's texture data, a run of 12-byte structs.

MO3T.name: Model Data
MO3T.note: The model's texture data, a run of 12-byte structs.

MO4T.name: Model Data
MO4T.note: The model's texture data, a run of 12-byte structs.

MO5T.name: Model Data
MO5T.note: The model's texture data, a run of 12-byte structs.

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The model the addon's data comes from.

RNAM.name: Primary Race
RNAM.note: The RACE the addon is primarily for. No preference is given for the races that are also listed, but it must have at least this one.

SNDD.name: Sound
SNDD.note: The sound the addon's material makes.

CLFM.name: Color
CLFM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/CLFM. [measured: 178 CLFM records in Skyrim.esm; CNAM is 4 bytes]

CNAM.name: Colour
CNAM.note: The red, green and blue channels. The fourth byte is always zero.

CONT.name: Container
CONT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/CONT. [measured: 436 CONT records in Skyrim.esm; DATA is 5 bytes and CNTO is 8]

CNTO.name: Container Object
CNTO.note: An item in the container and how many of it there are.

COCT.name: Object Count
COCT.note: How many CNTO and COED records follow.

COED.name: Owner And Health
COED.note: The owner and health of the item. It occurs once in the game data.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The container's flags and its weight, which is mis-aligned and always zero.

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The model, with the MODT and MODS fields.

QNAM.name: Close Sound
QNAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the container closes.

SNAM.name: Open Sound
SNAM.note: The sound (SNDR) played when the container opens.

MATT.name: Material
MATT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/MATT. [measured: 78 MATT records in Skyrim.esm; CNAM is 12 bytes]

BNAM.name: Buoyancy
BNAM.note: The material's buoyancy. The values in Skyrim.esm run from -1.0 to +1.0.

CNAM.name: Havok Display Colour
CNAM.note: The material's red, green and blue channels, each from 0.0 to 1.0.

PNAM.name: Parent Material
PNAM.note: The MATT record this one is based on.

SMBN.name: Story Manager Branch Node
SMBN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/SMBN. [measured: 99 SMBN records in Skyrim.esm]

CIS2.name: Variable Name
CIS2.note: An optional variable name, for example "::playerAllegiance_var".

DNAM.name: Flags
DNAM.note: The branch's flags. 0x01 is known, and very large values such as 0x10000 and 0x100000 occur.

PNAM.name: Parent
PNAM.note: The parent SMBN, SMEN or SMQN.

SNAM.name: Sibling
SNAM.note: Zero for the first child, or the prior sibling.
